newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: McConnell, Iddison in Vietnam j/venture.
newsitem.headline: McConnell, Iddison in Vietnam j/venture.

text.p: McConnell International and Iddison Group announced on Thursday they have reached agreement in principle regarding a joint interest in a pre-cast products joint venture in Hai Phong, Vietnam.
McConnell will take a 50 percent shareholding in Iddison subsidiary NZ Concrete Products to enter into the Vietnamese joint venture.
The joint venture will develop pre-cast and pre-stressed building products such as piles, beams and decks to service Vietnam's construction boom.
McConnell are already involved in a pre-cast concrete operation in the south of Vietnam as well as having interests in railways, transportation and construction in Vietnam.
It was intended to commence operations as soon as practicable.
